title: Homology under closed-immersion algebra direct image
statement: Let i : Z ⟶ Y be a closed immersion of schemes. The module direct-image functor over the direct-image algebra preserves homology of short complexes.

source.document: Stacks Project, Sheaves on Spaces and Sheaves of Modules

proof.text: Compute the direct-image stalk on the closed image and on its open complement, obtaining exactness on stalks; module-sheaf exactness is detected stalkwise.

theorem closedImmersion_algebraDirectImage_preservesHomology
